name: Sealwatch
description: A camp on the headland that counts the seals, and the sails.

bands.name: Hostile
bands.description: They have people who will not say your name.

bands.name: Cold
bands.description: They would not spit on you if you were burning.

bands.name: Wary
bands.description: They watch the ridge when you come.

bands.name: Friendly
bands.description: They will deal, and they will deal fairly.

bands.name: Sworn
bands.description: There are oaths between you now.
